name: Ghillie Murdo

intro.text: The Helmsdale is one of the finest salmon rivers in Scotland, and I've been on it since I was a boy. Let's see what you've caught.

win: Well, well. A good fish, that.
after: In 1869 the Strath of Kildonan, up the Helmsdale, had a gold rush. Hundreds of prospectors at the Kildonan burn, panning for Highland gold. A few got rich. The salmon got annoyed.
